newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans seen mixed, July down on weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans seen mixed, July down on weak cash.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were expected to open mixed, with old crop contracts down on weak cash markets, floor traders said.
"The bean basis is going down hard," said one floor trader.
Many cash merchandisers are now quoting basis bids over November or August futures. In most cases the switch represents a four- to 13-cent-per-bushel drop in flat prices, cash sources said.
New crop futures are expected to find support from weather forecasts showing continued cool temperatures in the Midwest.
Further weakness in July was also seen as traders continue to take profits on the July/November soybean spread, traders said.
